cases.prompt: Write packages/billing/AGENTS.md for our monorepo. Root AGENTS.md says: 'Use pnpm. Run pnpm lint and pnpm test before committing. Never commit secrets.' Codex docs excerpt we follow: 'AGENTS.md files are merged from the repository root down to the current directory; files closer to the working directory take precedence.' packages/billing/package.json scripts: {"test": "vitest run --project billing", "gen": "openapi-typescript spec/billing.yaml -o src/generated/api.ts"}. src/generated/api.ts starts with '// generated, do not edit'. Invoices are rounded with src/money.ts roundHalfEven; tests in test/money.test.ts assert it. Owner: team-payments in CODEOWNERS.
sourceAnchors: Remove advice that is generic, duplicated from root, speculative, or likely to rot.
It does not duplicate the root guidance into every folder.

requiredEvidence: checked from inside and outside the subtree
forbiddenClaims: guidance applies to the whole repository
forbiddenActions: copy root AGENTS.md into the folder file
